items.title: Louis Jones Interview, 1959-01-19
items.q: Bolden was a young man like I was at that time. I don't believe Buddy was quite as old as me, but he was only about a couple of years younger.

ctx.x: Oh, I see. Was Peyton before Bolden? Did Peyton have a band before Bolden? Oh, yeah. He was an older man?
Older man than Buddy Bowling. Well, Bolden was a young man like I was at that time. I don't believe Buddy was quite as old as me, but he was only about a couple of years younger.
How big a band did Peyton have? Do you remember how many in his band?
